data.label: 2D
data.note:
Skewed onto the triangular lattice; XZ Plane turns it so Y runs
along a diagonal, for when Y is vertical.

data.label: 3D
data.note:
Rotated, never skewed. XY Plane puts Z up the cubes' diagonal,
so XY slices (Z as time or height) look their best; XZ Plane
does it for Y; Classic is the diagonal rotation, more biased.
